create_interval_bounds: create IntervalBounds with lower and upper TensorFlow tensors for axis-aligned bounding box representation
apply_linear_bounds: apply linear transformation to IntervalBounds using weight matrix and bias vector via _affine method
apply_conv2d_bounds: apply 2D convolution to IntervalBounds with specified padding and stride parameters
apply_softmax_bounds: apply softmax operation to IntervalBounds computing tight lower and upper bounds via matrix diagonal technique
enable_bounds_caching: enable caching on IntervalBounds to reuse computed bounds across TensorFlow session.run calls
